title: Rank-one consistency probability
statement: Let $gamma$ be a vector and $Gamma$ a matrix over the field with two elements, both of dimension $n$. Choose $x,y$ independently and uniformly from the $n$-dimensional coordinate space. The rank-one consistency probability is the probability that $(gammacdot x)(gammacdot y)$ equals the matrix pairing of $Gamma$ with $x,y$.
